briefdescription.para: Aerosol dry deposition calculations for canopy model (sub-canopy)

detaileddescription.para:
Implements sub-canopy aerosol dry deposition following Katul et al. (2010) https://agupubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1029/2009JD012853 and issue #148. Calculates deposition velocities for aerosols in multilayer canopy.
NOAA ARL
